# kubesense_aws_account (Resource)

A AWS account integration. KubeSense checks the credentials when the integration is created and refuses ones that fail or belong to another account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kubesense_aws_account" "prod" {
  account_id = "123456789012"
  mode       = "role_access"
  role_arn   = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/KubeSenseCollectorRole"

  resource_types = {
    ec2 = { collect = true, metric_enabled = true }
    rds = { collect = true, metric_enabled = true, metric_tier = "expanded" }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) 12-digit AWS account id. Changing it creates a new integration.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether collection runs. false pauses it and keeps credentials and settings.
- `mode` (String) role_access (an IAM role KubeSense assumes, recommended), credentials (an access key) or service_account (the collector's own credentials).
- `resource_types` (Attributes Map) Resource types to collect, keyed by resource type (see Settings → Integrations for the names). When set, Terraform owns collection: types enabled in the UI but not listed here are switched off on the next apply. When omitted, collection is left to the UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_types))
- `role_arn` (String) ARN of the read-only IAM role, for mode = role_access.
- `secret_id` (String) Access key id, for mode = credentials.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key, for mode = credentials. Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI: the account name the credentials resolved to.
- `id` (String) Integration id (the API's kuid).
- `status` (String) pending, healthy, error, paused or deleting.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_types`

Required:

- `collect` (Boolean) Collect inventory.
- `metric_enabled` (Boolean) Collect metrics.

Optional:

- `metric_extras` (Set of String) Extra metric names beyond the tier.
- `metric_tier` (String) core (the default) or expanded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the integration's kuid, shown in Settings → Integrations.
terraform import kubesense_aws_account.prod 6c1f0a3e-8d2b-5e4f-9a7c-1b3d5f7e9a21
```
